name: The Legends Of Thumperville
source:
Wake with Victoria on festival morning in the valley of Thumperville — a place of gentle hills, carrot bread, and misty air where every heartbeat hums with warmth and wonder. Today should be a day of celebration, yet something deeper stirs within her — a quiet feeling that change is coming.

Step into a painted world alive with memory and light, where courage grows from the smallest choices, and love lingers in every whisper of the wind. Meet family, friends, and mysterious wanderers as you uncover the legend of the Blue Flame — a secret that binds the heart of the valley.

A tender, storybook journey about love, loss, and the courage to protect what matters most. Every moment, every scent of the festival air, carries the promise of legends yet to be born.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1009061]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
节日早晨，与维多利亚一起在桑珀维尔山谷醒来——这里有平缓的山丘、胡萝卜面包和薄雾弥漫的空气，每一次心跳都充满温暖和惊奇。今天应该是值得庆祝的一天，但她内心深处却有某种更深层次的东西在搅动——一种安静的感觉，改变即将到来。

走进一个充满记忆和光明的绘画世界，勇气从最小的选择中成长，爱在每一个风的低语中徘徊。与家人、朋友和神秘的流浪者见面，揭开蓝色火焰的传说——一个束缚山谷中心的秘密。

这是一段关于爱、失落和保护最重要事物的勇气的温柔故事书之旅。节日空气中的每一个瞬间、每一种气味，都承载着尚未诞生的传奇的承诺。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1009061]Newgrounds[/url]]
